CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 32
   C. 16
   D. 22

3. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 10
   C. 11
   D. 100

4. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 2

5. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

6. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 2/2
   D. They are equal

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

9. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

10. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

11. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 1

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

13. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 25

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 42
   C. 90
   D. 21

15. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 37
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 34
   B. 17
   C. 66
   D. 22

17. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 24.5
   C. 7
   D. 49

18. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

19. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 75
   B. 30
   C. 20
   D. 40

21. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

22. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

23. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

24. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 48
   D. 14

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
